# navigate_user_tool

> Navigate the user's app to an entity or surface.

| | |
|---|---|
| Category | `ui` |
| Callable | MCP clients; in-app @ai conversations (default) |
| Filter | `https://www.dsiloed.com/api/v1/mcp?tools=navigate_user_tool` |

## Description

This is the description the server sends to the model, verbatim.

Navigate the user's app to an entity or surface. Call this ONLY when
the user explicitly asked to GO somewhere ("take me to…", "open…",
"go to…"). If the user asks for a tour, to be shown around, to explore
an area, or how to DO something, use walk_user_tool instead — it
guides them step-by-step on screen and handles any navigation itself.
Never call this as a side effect of another request. Provide EITHER
entity (kind + id) OR surface, not both. The app OFFERS the navigation
to the user when your reply is delivered (they may have
auto-navigation enabled) — mention the destination in your reply.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `entity` | object | no | Destination entity (kind + id). Omit when using surface. |
| `entity.kind` | string | yes | Entity kind. One of: `task`, `project`, `conversation`, `file`. |
| `entity.id` | integer | yes | Entity id. |
| `surface` | string | no | Destination app surface (when no specific entity). Omit when using entity. One of: `gantt`, `projects`, `tickets`, `team-chat`, `files`, `ai-studio`. |
